test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct passive voice of the given sentence.**

The doctor told me to start taking medicines prescribed by him.

options.text: The doctor had told me to start taking medicines prescribed by him.
The doctor was told to start taking medicines prescribed by me daily.
I was told by the doctor to start taking medicines prescribed by him.
I had been told by the doctor to start taking medicines prescribed by him.

solution:
The correct answer is: **I was told by the doctor to start taking medicines prescribed by him.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Active Voice describes a sentence where the subject performs the action stated by the verb. While in the Passive Voice subject is acted upon by the verb.
 
• The given sentence is written in the Simple past tense.
 
• The structure of active voice = **Subject + V2+ object__**
 
• The structure of passive Voice = **__Object+ was/were + V3+ by + subject__**
 
• Rules of Conversion from Active to Passive Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
• Change the verb into the past participle form of the verb.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

Thus the passive voice will be: *I was told by the doctor to start taking medicines prescribed by him.*
